items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: Well, Harvey Rubin may be able to make a, or Laz Muscat may be able to make you a copy

ctx.x: I'd like to get another copy of that little, you know, I just cracked my little EP on that Basin Street Six. Oh, really? That Melancholy Rhapsody. I cracked my little 45 on that. And I don't think I'm going to be able to get another one.
Well, Harvey Rubin may be able to make a, or Laz Muscat may be able to make you a copy, because they've got all the equipment hooked up to copy deals.
Well, I have it on, I have it on a cassette. Yeah, that's what I'm talking about. I have it on a cassette. But my little 45 that I made my cassettes from, I cracked my 45.
